job.label: Short bow — Fine
job.keep_line: the same single short deep D-curved ash bow, upper nock at upper-left and lower nock at lower-right of its gentle diagonal, thick short limbs tapering to rounded nocks, broad spirally rawhide-wrapped grip on the curved right side and a single straight taut dark string closing the D on the left. Preserve the exact limb curvature, wood facets, nock-end cord bindings, rawhide overlaps, open interior and string endpoints; the nocks do not curl or reflex. Add one thin carved line along the face of each limb (along the side of the stock on a crossbow; down the long face of the quiver, stitched). Nothing else is added. Apply those surface changes only to the first reference. Retain pale ash and natural tan rawhide, with no coloured accent. The ONE new thin uncoloured carved line follows the face of EACH matching limb, inside the existing wood face; no inlay colour, ornament, repair, arrow, quiver or added hardware. Keep the string attached to exactly the same rounded nock endpoints. No curled or reflexed tips. Do not add, remove, relocate or resize any part or opening. Hand-painted opaque gouache and ink, broken directional strokes and selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges, upper-left light. Full transparent background,1024x1024RGBA, same framing and at least50px clear margin. No cast shadow, ground, scene, figure, hand, text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, frame, border or external glow. This is an exterior painted illustration only, no diagram, measurements, assembly steps or operating instructions.
